summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute a shipped obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs") runs setup.mjs, which either uses a locally-installed `bun` or downloads the Bun v1.3.13 runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~730KB single-line Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) containing a string-array rotation routine (function WV8StW shuffling table n7gIxM), hex-named identifiers, and thousands of packed numeric constants; no source form is shipped. The declared purpose of the package is React repo/lint configuration, which has no legitimate need to fetch an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque bundled payload. Executing the payload under Bun (rather than Node) means Node-based static analysis never sees the code that actually runs on the installer's machine — the alternate-runtime-dropper evasion pattern. The fetched Bun binary is not the harmful content; the harm is that math_init.js — an obfuscated blob whose behavior cannot be determined from its shipped form — is auto-executed on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
